subject: Your motor neurons are stronger in the afternoon
script: From Agewell Brief: Your motor neurons are stronger in the afternoon. New research shows that the spinal cord's built-in amplifier—persistent inward currents—boosts muscle output more in the late afternoon, revealing a circadian rhythm in neural excitability. PIC prolongation and amplification increase in the afternoon, enhancing motor neuron output. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
